name: Chat EOF and two-turn test
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--gemma-3-270m-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && timeout 60 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin < /dev/null > /tmp/chatnull2.log 2>&1; echo NULL-EXIT=$?; printf "Hello\nThe capital of France is\n" | timeout 120 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin > /tmp/chat2turn.log 2>&1; echo TURN-EXIT=$?; echo "--- null tail:"; tail -2 /tmp/chatnull2.log | cut -c1-50; echo "--- 2turn responses:"; grep -a -A3 "^> " /tmp/chat2turn.log | cut -c1-65 | head -10'
